01运行前的观察目标02读取真实双头梯度，并构造一次方向抵消03代码说明

运行前先预测关键输出，再对照断言和下方代码说明。核对通过后，尝试只改变一个输入或配置，解释输出为什么变化。

运行前的观察目标

一般回归与四类分类的加权共享梯度等于总目标反向结果；确定性二维反例得到 [-2,-2] 与 [2,2]，等权组合为零。

python 46_multitask-gradients_demo.py环境配置

读取真实双头梯度，并构造一次方向抵消

46_multitask-gradients_demo.py
import torchfrom torch import nnfrom torch.nn import functional as F torch.manual_seed(34)# STEP 1: 连续向量回归与四类状态分类共享主干trunk = nn.Linear(3, 4)action_head = nn.Linear(4, 2)state_head = nn.Linear(4, 4)x = torch.randn(5, 3)action_target = torch.randn(5, 2)state_target = torch.tensor([0, 1, 2, 3, 1])hidden = torch.tanh(trunk(x))loss_action = (action_head(hidden) - action_target).square().mean()loss_state = F.cross_entropy(state_head(hidden), state_target)shared = tuple(trunk.parameters()) # STEP 2: 读取相同共享坐标，核验加权梯度恒等式ga_parts = torch.autograd.grad(loss_action, shared, retain_graph=True)gs_parts = torch.autograd.grad(loss_state, shared, retain_graph=True)ga = torch.cat([g.reshape(-1) for g in ga_parts])gs = torch.cat([g.reshape(-1) for g in gs_parts])denominator = ga.norm() * gs.norm()cosine = None if float(denominator) == 0 else float(torch.dot(ga, gs) / denominator)assert all(p.grad is None for p in shared)weight = 0.25(loss_action + weight * loss_state).backward()combined = torch.cat([p.grad.reshape(-1) for p in shared])torch.testing.assert_close(combined, ga + weight * gs)print('回归 / 分类 loss:', float(loss_action.detach()), float(loss_state.detach()))print('共享梯度范数:', float(ga.norm()), float(gs.norm()), '余弦:', cosine) # STEP 3: 确定性相反目标，区分数学反例与随机网络观察point = torch.tensor([0.0, 0.0], requires_grad=True)toward_positive = (point - 1).square().sum()toward_negative = (point + 1).square().sum()gp = torch.autograd.grad(toward_positive, point, retain_graph=True)[0]gn = torch.autograd.grad(toward_negative, point)[0]torch.testing.assert_close(gp, torch.tensor([-2.0, -2.0]))torch.testing.assert_close(gn, -gp)torch.testing.assert_close(gp + gn, torch.zeros(2))print('构造案例：相反梯度等权组合为', (gp + gn).tolist())print('通过：真实回归与分类梯度组合，以及确定性抵消反例')
